A CLASSIC GAME, WITH A SPOOKY LITTLE TWIST

From printer to party in minutes.

01

Print your set

Choose US Letter or A4. Print at actual size, then cut out the calling cards.

02

Pass out the fun

Give everyone a card and a pencil or counters. On a 5 × 5 card, mark the FREE center.

03

Draw & find

Shuffle the calling cards. Draw one, say the name, and show it. Players mark a matching picture.

04

Shout “Bingo!”

Complete a row, column, or diagonal to win. Check the drawn cards—and celebrate!

Different layouts keep things interesting. More than one player can win on the same draw.

A FEW LITTLE ANSWERS

Good to know
before you play.

What paper size should I use?

The ready-made Halloween bingo printable uses US Letter (8.5 × 11 inches). The generator also supports A4. Each game card gets its own page. Select the matching paper size and print at 100% or Actual size.

How many people can play?

Download the 30-card set for a classroom, or use the Halloween bingo generator to make 1–50 different cards in a batch. A 3 × 3 grid is a simple starting point for younger kids.

Are these Halloween bingo cards really free?

Yes! Generate, download, and print free Halloween bingo cards for your classroom, family, or party. There’s no account, payment, or email required.

How do I use the calling cards?

Cut out the calling cards included in your PDF and shuffle them in a bowl or bag. Draw one at a time, read the name, and show the picture. Keep drawn cards aside to check a “Bingo!”

Is this Halloween bingo for kids?

Absolutely. All 36 illustrations are friendly and classroom-ready, with clear English labels. Choose the white-background ink saver style for easy printing and a little coloring fun.
